subject.title: Make adaptive refresh agent-aware on fresh installs

question: Should selecting or inheriting Adaptive authorize recurring local process and transcript-metadata scans, or must scanning remain behind explicit Agent Sessions consent or a separately persisted fresh-install enrollment?
rationale: Current main treats Agent Sessions as an explicit setting, while this PR makes its local observation run for all Adaptive users; implementation evidence cannot decide the intended privacy and upgrade contract.

options.title: Persist Fresh-Install Enrollment
options.body: Authorize local activity scanning only for newly enrolled installs and preserve existing Adaptive users’ prior no-scan behavior.

options.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Keep local activity scanning behind the existing Agent Sessions setting or a new dedicated preference.

options.title: Make Adaptive Imply Scanning
options.body: Accept that every Adaptive user authorizes the bounded local scan and document the upgrade behavior prominently.

recommendation.title: Persist Fresh-Install Enrollment
recommendation.body: Authorize local activity scanning only for newly enrolled installs and preserve existing Adaptive users’ prior no-scan behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Agent Sessions introduction and default-off change establish the closest ownership for this product and privacy choice.
